verdict.rationale: Daily is a real-time video and voice API platform, and a platform like this could plausibly offer scheduled automation, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows event-triggered actions, such as recording that starts when a token holder joins and server-side reactions to call events. These are one-off triggers, not recurring schedules, and nothing in the pack documents scheduling recurring jobs or workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
